profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Duolingo
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software engineer with 5 years at Duolingo building web and mobile features at scale. I've shipped products driving tens of millions of daily users — from monetization features generating +$30K/day to a cross-platform product rebrand coordinating 10+ engineers across three teams. Currently building iOS features to bridge Duolingo's certified English test and the core learning app product.

I’m passionate about education, sustainability, and community building, and would love to connect with similar mission-driven organizations. I'm also a creative at heart with a variety of hobbies in visual and performing arts. Our lives are supported by the communities around us, and I want to play a part in shaping this ever-changing, increasingly technogical future.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Project lead for the Duolingo English Test (DET) product rebrand, coordinating 10+ engineers across 3 teams and driving +8% DAUs post-launch.
- Currently building iOS mobile features for the DET and Duolingo Score to bridge the certified test and the core Duolingo learning app.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led and shipped full-stack monetization features on the Duolingo web app, including learned words list, mistakes practice, and age-restricted social features (+37K DAUs). Shipped a Stripe webview purchase flow on iOS generating +$30K/day.
- Drove web platform improvements and established company-wide web linting standards to improve dev experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and launched core monetization features including the Purchase Flow redesign, Super Duolingo rebrand, B2B partner promos, and New Year's Promo (+$10K/day). 
- Shipped the Practice Hub web port end-to-end, including new backend session types in Python and Kotlin services.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: TA for CS 3240 (Software Engineering). Managed project groups in a 300-person class on software design principles, agile methodologies, and full-stack web development using Django, PostgreSQL, and Heroku.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Leading a 15-member student development & publicity team to build and maintain the premier UVA course review site serving 41,000+ users (​thecourseforum.com)​
- Guiding migration from legacy Ruby on Rails application to a Dockerized Django application (tCF 2.0)
- Overhauling legacy CSV parser to fetch JSON data from public course APIs
- Configuring autoscaling with Kubernetes to handle peak periods during registration season

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern | Workspace One UEM
positions.description:
Created a RESTful API microservice that allows IT admins to validate workflows for device setup and installation, built with C# and ASP.NET Core
- Saved enterprise clients 2-4 hours of time per installation workflow
- Deployed application to an AWS EC2 instance

positions.title: Technology Development Intern | EASE Platforms Team
positions.description:
- Developed a direct contributor notification system for mobile application crashes, backed by AWS Lambda and Slack & Jira API services. Optimized crash triaging response time by 8 hours for the mobile features team.
- Expedited code reviews on pull requests with a Ruby Fastlane plugin to lint the GitHub CODEOWNERS file in the Jenkins CI/CD pipeline.

positions.title: Technical Intern | Data Liberation Division
positions.description:
Designed and prototyped a novel geotemporal radar web visualization tool for MTI data analyst intelligence reports on proprietary government data sets
- Built using ReactJS, Deck.gl and Spring Boot REST services
